## Appearance

Phil Gordon has big brown eyes, brown-tinted hair, and curls. She is also known for her crooked smile.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Confidences P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003)_

## Personality

Phil is an unselfish and loyal individual who possesses a charming, playful nature, even if she can occasionally be a little thoughtless and indecisive. She views her own purpose as one of charm and allure, while actively working toward the goal of having [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) ask her to marry him. Highly skilled in mathematics, she is capable of taking prestigious academic scholarships, and her deft fingers also excel at embroidery, alongside basic household skills like sweeping floors and washing dishes. Her primary fear is a deep-seated horror of scarlet fever.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Interlude P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 ch.Speaks P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), +3 more_

## History

Philippa "Phil" Gordon, a lively and wealthy student from an exclusive family in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while exploring Old St. John's Cemetery on their first day at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). The three quickly formed a close friendship, and after [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arranged to rent a house called Patty's Place, Phil asked to join their household for the following school year. While living at Patty's Place, she frequently entertained various suitors, but her romantic path changed during a summer trip when she met [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/blake.md), a theological student. Deeply moved after hearing him preach, Phil fell in love with him and eventually accepted his proposal, prioritizing him over her other admirers. Throughout college, Phil remained a confidante to [Anne](../character/anne.md), comforting and confronting her through various romantic dilemmas involving [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). Following graduation, Phil married [Jonas](../character/jonas.md). Years later, she and her husband attended Anne's wedding at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), by which point Phil had become thin after having babies of her own.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P4](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0004), [v3 ch.Lady P9](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0009), [v3 ch.Lady P13](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0013), [v3 ch.Lady P16](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0016), [v3 ch.Lady P22](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0022), [v3 ch.Lady P25](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0025), +659 more_

## Quotes

> "Heaps. The boys like me awfully—they really do. But there were only two that mattered. The rest were all too young and too poor. I must marry a rich man, you know."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Lady P50](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0050)

> "And let me come to see you. I want to be chummy with you. I’ve taken such a fancy to you both. And I haven’t quite disgusted you with my frivolity, have I?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Lady P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060)

> "I’ll go, if I can walk with Priscilla and Charlie. That will be a bearable degree of gooseberry. That Gilbert of yours is a darling, Anne, but why does he go around so much with Goggle-eyes?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)

> "I don’t want William’s Island especially, but I’m sure I couldn’t get it if I did. Look at that sentry on the summit of the fort, right beside the flag. Doesn’t he look as if he had stepped out of a romance?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P25](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0025)

> "Look—in white letters, around the archway over the gate. ‘Patty’s Place.’ Isn’t that killing? Especially on this Avenue of Pinehursts and Elmwolds and Cedarcrofts? ‘Patty’s Place,’ if you please! I adore it."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--phil-gordon.md)

Phil and [Anne](../character/anne.md) formed a close friendship after meeting at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and eventually moved into Patty's Place together as housemates. ### [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

Phil first met theological student [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/blake.md) while staying at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) over the summer, initially finding him funny and plain. After hearing him preach a moving sermon, her feelings shifted into deep admiration, leading them to become close companions through fishing, boating, and walking together. Their connection blossomed into love, ultimately leading to their engagement and marriage.
